title: Measured HTC
description: A measured Heat Transfer Coefficient value with provenance metadata. In current h3 workflows, htc_value_w_per_k is the calibration target and an index window can be used to align analysis rows.

htc_value_w_per_k.description: The measured whole-building HTC in watts per kelvin (W/K). This is the primary numeric target used by h3 run/calibrate comparisons.

uncertainty_w_per_k.description: Uncertainty on the HTC value (+/-W/K), or null if unknown. Stored for provenance and future weighting; not currently used in h3 calculations.

window.description: The observation window over which the HTC was measured. In current h3 logic, type=index can auto-align analysis rows when no explicit CLI window is provided.

oneOf.description: Labels describing the measurement boundary conditions.

method_profile.description: Method profile labelling boundary conditions for HTC comparison. Metadata only in current h3 calculations.

oneOf.description: Conditions under which the measurement was taken.

occupancy_mode.description: Whether the dwelling was occupied during the measurement.

conditions.description: Measurement conditions (occupancy, etc.). Metadata only in current h3 calculations.

source.description: Provenance label, e.g. 'SMETER', 'coheating_provider_X', 'synthetic'. Metadata only in current h3 calculations.

notes.description: Free-text notes. Metadata only in current h3 calculations.
